system.description:
You create a visual image of your own description that grabs and restrains a creature you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom Saving throw. This jutsu has no effect on undead, constructs, plants, or Demons.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creatures mind is wounded, as they take 3d12 psychic damage.

Failure: Affected creature becomes Stunned until the end of your next turn and takes 4d12 psychic damage.

Critical Failure: Same effect as failure, but affected creature is Stunned for the duration and remakes its saves at the end of each of its turns or when it takes damage, ending this jutsu’s effect on it, on a success.
